source_findings.title: Projective plane proofs
holdings: DRAT certificates and generation scripts for weight-19 cases
source_findings.finding: Provides modern machine-checkable certificates for major cases used in the historical proof, with some complete weight-19 certificates too large for direct download but reproducible from published scripts.

retained_limitations: Exact dates and complete execution logs for every historical search run were not recovered and must not be inferred from publication dates.
The original historical source code, machine environment, intermediate files, and all raw search outputs were not preserved in this repository review.

Modern SAT/DRAT work independently verifies major proof cases, but the largest complete weight-19 certificate corpus is not directly downloadable because of its size and instead depends on published generation and verification scripts.
The historical proof result, later independent verification, publication, disciplinary acceptance, and modern certificate availability are distinct events and must remain separately coded.
This receipt improves provenance but does not establish full byte-level reconstruction of the complete 1980s computation.

coding_effect.independent_coder_may_use: Only after a versioned packet update that preserves the retained limitations and distinguishes historical computation from modern certificate verification.
coding_effect.confidence_effect: Primary publication chronology and independent-verification posture improved; exact historical run chronology remains incomplete.

completion_boundary: SRC-002 is terminal as LIMITATION_RETAINED. This receipt does not claim complete reconstruction of the original computation, erase the verification gap, or confirm the TIDC hypothesis.
